name: mini-sumo
description: Mini Sumo: a browser-based 3D multiplayer party game built with React Three Fiber and Colyseus.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mini-sumo/server && npm run build -w @mini-sumo/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @mini-sumo/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @mini-sumo/server && npm run typecheck -w @mini-sumo/client
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mini-sumo/client
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @mini-sumo/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run dist -w @mini-sumo/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npm run android:sync -w @mini-sumo/mobile
